executive_summary: Hacksaw AB (publ) is an online casino game developer seeking to IPO in June 2025 at 77 SEK per share, with a single operating segment focused on licensing games to gaming operators through usage-based royalty arrangements. The prospectus emphasizes standard regulatory disclosures and accounting policies rather than operational narrative.
key_highlights: IPO offering at 77 SEK per share with trading commencing 25 June 2025
Single operating segment in online casino solutions and gaming operator licensing
Revenue recognition based on usage-based royalties from end-user gameplay
Capitalized game development expenditure amortized over 4 years
Intangible assets include platform development and trademark rights
Share-based warrant incentive program for senior executives
All financial amounts reported in EUR despite Swedish listing
